ProjectionRace.scope: The automatic editable-page replacement refusal and human-adoption ownership boundary, versus a rejected read-check-unconditional-replace proposal. The isolated requireSafeBodyReplacement helper and automaticSourceStops retain their refusal contracts. Explicit changed-body restore uses a separate complete-old-body-match protocol and no longer calls the helper. A safe terminal refusal is not successful automatic update progress.
excluded: Provider revision-CAS
atomic old-string matching
enforced UI edit exclusion
multi-page API transactions
Explicit manual authoring writer protocol and all-writer guard coverage
Explicit complete-old-body-match restore and request submission authorization

UpdateCommit.scope: A bounded abstraction of one already-authorized selection write, two exact resource identities, two selected revisions and one existing session. Complete preparation precedes selection; an unknown original outcome cannot be invented from current equality. This is not a refinement proof of all source coordinator dispatches or a transaction across selection and readable projection.
excluded: Multiple writers or processes with different Stores
credential rotation
provider permission propagation
automatic Notion projection writes
arbitrary Git filesystem semantics
Source batch and periodic-run scheduling
Fixed-manifest storage codec, byte limits, canonical payload-cache behavior and immutable Record reconciliation

AuditRun.scope: Two surviving Skill roots, one orphan visible to the reverse census, one changed body, a one-Skill slice budget and up to two resumptions. The implemented coordinator performs initial/final registered-table census, durable task progress and a read-only semantic boundary; this finite model abstracts those operations and does not prove their HTTP accounting, SQLite durability or complete real-library coverage.
excluded: Arbitrary concurrent table changes or a global database snapshot
HTTP pagination and request/byte/deadline accounting
Endpoint and credential scope fences
SQLite crash atomicity
Durable scheduler availability
Automatic repair
Unknown historical data absent from every retained index
Metadata-only census selector and its unobserved Skill-body result
Native unregistered draft classification and stored v1 versus resumable v2 audit rules

implemented_boundary.scope: The read-only transport restricts descendant helpers, including legacy Notion requests, before scheduling. The real-code mutation gate removes this guard around an otherwise auto-adopting observer and requires the independent zero-write assertion to fail.

ImportCreate.scope: One explicitly enabled original create, two complete input objects and four abstract mutable stages: root allocation, Files/resources, metadata/selection and enablement. Preparation freezes approved bytes, the first dispatch rechecks the original local input, stage confirmation requires its durable original ACK, and explicit enablement follows complete verification. Lost-response absence cannot authorize replay; an acknowledged interrupted readback can be reconciled. This remains the original create execution/reconciliation abstraction; the separately reviewed acknowledged-prefix recovery protocol is excluded.
excluded: Disabled creation
Arbitrary file counts, chunking, Markdown projection versions including v9 creation spacing and v10 literal/fence serialization, Record compression and logical/wire byte limits
C1/N1/C2 classification and provider/member acquisition
Concurrent human editing or a filesystem transaction during dispatch
Immutable content-addressed Record reconciliation
Credential rotation, distributed writers or global exactly-once delivery
The separately reviewed v1/v8 and v1/v9 prefix/known-failure recovery protocols; CreateRecovery has its own bounded mapping
Versioned prefix recovery completion, pending-create suppression and cold history/read reconstruction
Projection-14 first complete import readback, portable input fingerprints and read-only completed-import reuse

CreateRecovery.scope: A v1/v9 recovery with one original main ACK and no original terminal, or three original native ACKs and a retained needs_review terminal; one abstract missing suffix and three mutable stages. Review/apply require the complete original evidence. An uncertain intermediate recovery never redispatches or advances through reconciliation. Exact Projection metadata authority must be checked before transport, with all initial files/events verified before enablement. The two operation histories and original native pages remain separate.
excluded: Actual 76-dispatch and 35-native/407-effective-file cardinality
Request/ACK serialization, cryptographic hashes, gzip, rich-text framing and SQLite durability
Markdown v9/v10 rendering, retained wire bytes and compact full-response observations
Cold completion and arbitrary consumer/history reconstruction
Concurrent edits after a stage's current observation, distributed writers and provider CAS
The historical v8-to-v9 recovery variant and original create/reconcile transitions
Arbitrary suffixes, immutable Record dispatch/reconciliation and all-writer authorization

AcknowledgedContinuation.scope: Two explicit finite branches. The retained fixed-source continuation starts with three already allocated pages and four stages. NativeRestoration starts with one original acknowledged main and one original unattempted reference, adding a single native allocation stage before the complete initial event set. Both vary exact original request/ACK authority, preserve the original pages and needs_review history, check a fresh body before each new stage, and retain a separate completion. A request with its exact durable ACK can return from interrupted readback to verification without increasing attempts; visibility without that ACK never authorizes redispatch. Enablement requires every native page and initial event; cold verification requires the full original shared proof set and complete verified stages.
excluded: Actual 34/35 native and 397/407 full-file cardinality or arbitrary suffix counts
Exact frozen request/response JSON, cryptographic hashes, 64 KiB envelopes, original local Store scope and rich-text transport
Markdown rendering, automatic-link repair, complete source acquisition and retained-policy compatibility
Edits occurring after a stage observation, distributed writers, provider CAS and atomic multi-page writes
Every immutable Record subrequest, recovery version codecs, generic interrupted-operation restart and unknown-success inference
Other recovery branches and public CLI/SDK/Pi execution

AuditScope.scope: One selected owner with four abstract fact groups, target versus independent full reverse scope, two-read budget and one resume. Actual source guards and concrete limitations are reviewed in docs/maintenance-verification-review.md.
excluded: HTTP pagination, bytes and exact request cost
Real Notion permissions and concurrent changes
Actual body, reference and Record byte integrity
Arbitrary dependency graphs or all private session pins
Repair authorization and write execution

review_basis: The synchronized commit and content hashes bind reviewed runtime correspondence, not a full refinement proof. Public CLI, installed SDK, real Notion/provider/UI behavior and physical machines require independent evidence. Prior ProjectionRace, UpdateCommit, AuditRun, ImportCreate and CreateRecovery inputs and receipts are retained unchanged. The five retained and five NativeRestoration AcknowledgedContinuation configurations were checked together in formal-native-restoration-v3; their unchanged model/config/view inputs retain those original named-positive and negative-control results. Original failed runtime and tool invocations remain separate. Native inventory immutable-Record prefix recovery, consumption-effect disclosure, strict-read-only routing, request attribution and header reuse are hash-bound implementation context only. The new independent native file-add current acceptance is explicitly unmodeled: it supplies its own reviewed adoption/completion, never an original ACK or successful original add outcome. Current source correspondence and direct tests do not turn earlier TLC results into a proof of this separate decision. No source hash alone establishes an invariant, liveness property or task completion.

unmodeled_bindings.name: local_inventory_entrypoint_selection
unmodeled_bindings.scope: Local filesystem discovery and root entrypoint preference are outside the finite lifecycle models. Within an existing entity root, an exact SKILL.md takes precedence while all supporting files and fallback boundaries remain. A new observation binds the selected main in its manifest and review identity; retained reports and prepared plans keep their original main. This hash binds reviewed scanner context only and adds no model, invariant or liveness claim.

unmodeled_bindings.name: fixed_manifest_storage
unmodeled_bindings.scope: The logical envelope identity stays separate from physical storage. The lifecycle models do not model gzip/Base64, logical or wire byte limits, arbitrary manifest cardinality, rich-text transport, cache representation or immutable Record reconciliation. An original Records POST with a validated durable request/response ACK may observe the exact response page ID by GET. It reuses full active-page, Records ownership, Skill relation and canonical envelope/payload validation, then requires the frozen original logical envelope. Query-index visibility is not required for this acknowledged observation. Unknown, absent or invalid ACKs acquire no such authority; no POST replay or recovery version is added. This exact GET path remains outside all six models. These hashes bind reviewed implementation context only.

unmodeled_bindings.name: native_projection_versions
unmodeled_bindings.scope: Projection versions, literal-token escaping, document spacing, preserved submitted wire bytes and actual Notion rendering remain outside every model. ImportCreate treats the frozen candidate/readback as abstract values; CreateRecovery fixes the v9-to-v10 decision without proving its bytes. ProjectionRace concerns automatic refusal of unsafe existing-body replacement, not explicit complete-match restore. Explicit old policies remain fixed. Policy 11 handles observed literal escaping in parsed top-level heading text; exact supporting YAML retention is separately bound below. Policy 12 adds purpose-specific observed separators: body_write ATX heading to paragraph and paragraph to fenced code, and data_source_create ATX heading to list or fenced code. Policy 13 extends only data_source_create for fully reconstructed top-level loose decimal-dot ordered lists. All items must start with a single-line paragraph; multi-block items must include a backtick fence and a continuation paragraph and contain only supported paragraphs, fences and simple non-task unordered child lists. At least one item must be multi-block. Its expected readback wraps continuation paragraphs and adjusts those separators. Other list shapes, body-write results, original wire and retained policies 1-12 preserve their prior behavior. The minimal repository list regression and one external complete native81 input/readback comparison are distinct evidence. Neither establishes arbitrary rendering, changes historical recovery decisions or supplies a finite-model proof.

evidence.scope: External retained comparison of one complete 12563-byte native81 input with its independent captured Notion readback, preserving original v12 and submitted-wire hashes. The receipt and its historical fixture digest remain unchanged; the repository regression is minimized separately. This is not a new live run, an arbitrary-input claim or a model result.

unmodeled_bindings.name: creation_recovery_payload_and_cold_completion
unmodeled_bindings.scope: The historical v1/v8 main-ACK-before-manifest protocol remains unmodeled. CreateRecovery models only the explicit bounded state/authority mapping for the v9 known-failure or sole-main branch. Full journal/dispatch/ACK content validation, exact Source and native metadata, compact observations, versioned v3/v4 payloads, complete retained objects, cold completion and pending-create suppression remain hash-bound reviewed context, not a consumer refinement proof. ACK and recovery proof schemas are leaf data dependencies; ESM initialization order requires real fresh Node checks and is not established by TLC.

unmodeled_bindings.name: complete_native_headers_and_restore_projection
unmodeled_bindings.scope: Complete input and retained header serialization are outside the finite models. New file-add v2 retains the exact original supporting header and input; source creation v11 retains C1 and N1 header/mode ancestry. Explicit write/apply check fresh consumer headers against retained native ownership before dispatch. Restore-follow uses the selected native creation projection for exact no-body-write comparison. A differing-body explicit restore uses the single_full_body_match capability: one nonempty complete old-body match, frozen-input revalidation before dispatch and exact full candidate readback before accepting the following state. It no longer calls requireSafeBodyReplacement. This explicit writer protocol is not page revision CAS, permits no unknown-write replay and remains outside ProjectionRace and every other finite model. Old plan identities and unprojected plans remain accepted by their original contracts. The consumer and authoring paths both recognize .md and .markdown, so an explicit edit restores same-owner relative references to their exact bound native pages. This byte-level round trip remains outside the finite models.

unmodeled_bindings.name: source_batch_sqlite_checkpoints
unmodeled_bindings.scope: SQLite address registration and checkpoint persistence are outside UpdateCommit and AuditRun. Only exact operations/shared-source-batches/<scope SHA>/source-batch-<plan SHA>/<run UUID>.json addresses become mutable run checkpoints; original source member dispatch, ACK and selection facts remain immutable. Retired runs cannot be reopened. Real Node processes test dry/apply/reconcile with one original batch and independent run records; memory Store fixtures do not establish durability.

unmodeled_bindings.name: compact_native_ack_proofs_and_v11_recovery
unmodeled_bindings.scope: New review v4/outcome v5 handles an original v10 known fixed-Git failure. Continuation review v2/outcome v6 applies only to an exact known v3/v10 recovery whose entire native allocation set has durable original ACKs before metadata/events/enablement. Compact file commitments are independently reconstructed from the full retained original plan and explicit v11 policy, including all native metadata/events. Separate ordinary bounded object Records retain each full frozen POST and original ACK; immutable response hashes alone do not establish cold authority. The model abstracts the complete-set and cold-proof predicates but does not prove byte serialization, field schemas, real cardinality, SQLite, ESM startup or every consumer. Old review/outcome meanings remain fixed.

unmodeled_bindings.name: explicit_body_review_native_metadata_and_versioned_reconciliation
unmodeled_bindings.scope: New body review plan v2 binds only the original candidate native mode and complete frontmatter to the exact retained observed body. The original review operation ID and existing opaque journal-address hash remain unchanged; retained local/shared v1 plans determine historical replay. Missing or conflicting original facts never authorize a replacement dispatch. The exact file/operation opaque key in the same Store forbids a fresh dispatch after a credential-scope change, without reading another scope payload. An empty independent Store cannot infer another host unknown request; this is not distributed mutual exclusion or provider CAS. Historical v1 plan/event/receipt bytes and no-write reconciliation remain required. Explicit manual review codecs, version selection, same-Store opaque routing and cold completion are not modeled transitions in ProjectionRace, UpdateCommit, ImportCreate or the other finite models. Existing abstract invariants and guard proofs do not establish these metadata or address checks.

unmodeled_bindings.name: native_inventory_main_ack_recovery_and_cold_completion
unmodeled_bindings.scope: Native inventory review v5/outcome v7 is a separate unmodeled branch for a v1 complete one-main Skill acknowledged under projection 11 before any Records. Exact original prepared/executed inventory intent, credential-scoped create journal and the sole full original POST/ACK are required before the fixed projection-12 decision. The disabled/default-false page, original wire, full input, mode and frontmatter remain unchanged; no Source, resources, Members or Requires are admitted. Apply appends only the exact immutable Record union and creates no Skill/File page, metadata/body PATCH or enablement. A complete repeated attempt reconciles its original result. A partial attempt may continue only a contiguous exact Record prefix with complete same-scope original dispatches and durable ACKs, exact current acknowledged Record pages and a fresh unchanged disabled native body. Only the never-dispatched tail is authorized; missing or changed ACKs, extra or foreign dispatches and unknown requests remain read-only. This bounded immutable-Record continuation is unmodeled and changes no old review or outcome codec. Cold completion reconstructs the full original plan and validates complete shared ACK/body/event facts; the dispatch-set commitment uses those same validated ACK payloads without a second query. This is historical completion, not current-body atomicity or distributed exclusion. The existing ImportCreate, CreateRecovery and AcknowledgedContinuation models do not acquire this branch, new transitions, invariants or liveness claims. Original recovery contracts remain fixed; direct code counterexamples and installed/live execution provide separate evidence.

unmodeled_bindings.name: explicit_file_request_submission
unmodeled_bindings.scope: The request command defaults to read-only inspection. --submit freezes the complete observed body fingerprint/size, event frontier, file identity and Source context in Management Receipt; its dry-run writes nothing. A dropdown alone expresses intent and does not authorize replacement. --process consumes the submitted receipt, permitting only a verified selected-version advance within the same Source definition/member; later body/frontier edits, cancellation, moves or rebinding require fresh submission. --submit, --process and --reconcile are mutually exclusive. Feedback neither clears user intent nor treats Status as permission. The actual restore plan and retained bodies are verified before its ID is written and read back in processing feedback; no preceding processing/null write is needed. Exact feedback metadata acknowledgment is separate from current complete-context eligibility, so a later body edit stops before body dispatch without converting a known metadata ACK into an unknown mutation. Existing guardedSourceMutation rules still prohibit accepting unknown writes from matching fields. Legacy --reconcile --operation binds the validated original plan to its submitted file/preimage/frontier/Source and requires exact original outcome/event; no current-text equality creates success. A verified not-applied original permits only an explicit new submission, while pending and unknown originals cannot be replaced. Historical verified receipts without submitted retain their prior read-only contract. These request/feedback transitions, the callback and explicit complete-body-match restore remain outside all six finite models, including ProjectionRace's excluded explicit writer/request authorization and AcknowledgedContinuation's unrelated create branches. No model, configuration, view, transition or prior model result changes or acquires these claims.

unmodeled_bindings.name: registered_metadata_census
unmodeled_bindings.scope: Census permits metadata depth only, rejects pin/graph scopes, compares semantic registered-table rows before and after inventory, and does not enqueue per-Skill observation. Skill states remain unobserved; a completed census is not a content audit. The existing read-only Notion transport remains in force. This selector is not a transition of AuditRun.

unmodeled_bindings.name: native_import_readback_and_completed_input_reuse
unmodeled_bindings.scope: Complete portable input fingerprints include the entrypoint and each relative path/hash/size/mode, not machine paths or Notion presentation. A reused native import needs the exact library/Skill, original manifest and complete applied outcome; it returns read-only and leaves current content unobserved. Projection 14 applies only to new data-source creation, compares text/code/explicit link destinations, freezes the first complete native readback, retains its exact body/events and rejects later differing readbacks. It never authorizes existing-body overwrite or changes fixed source bytes or tombstone history. Original successful POST responses may identify exact allocated pages before query visibility; conflicting identity queries and invalid ownership fail, and missing ACKs never authorize retry. Batch/readback SQLite addresses remain dispatch records. These implementation details and serialization policies are outside ImportCreate, CreateRecovery and AcknowledgedContinuation.

unmodeled_bindings.name: ordinary_native_restoration_codec_and_request_diagnostics
unmodeled_bindings.scope: The AcknowledgedContinuation native branch abstracts original authority, stage order, ACK-only readback continuation and cold proof requirements only. Exact original plan/review/outcome hashes, one-main scope, full original POST/ACK metadata, retained input reconstruction, unchanged same-page body and relation checks, separate immutable records and Node ESM initialization remain product-test obligations. Request phase/owner fields, compact-header reuse, consumption-effect disclosure and strict-read-only handling do not change this state model or prove every authoring request is classified. Unknown attribution remains explicit.

unmodeled_bindings.name: author_request_lineage_and_current_acceptance_diagnostics
unmodeled_bindings.scope: The earlier author-lineage synchronization changed diagnostic context and one recovery message only. The later independent add-acceptance behavior is mapped separately below. Actual parent apply Records bind the parent operation; body/metadata children override it with their own exact operation. Author preflight, dispatch, verify and original reconciliation are annotated at existing call boundaries without adding requests, authority, retries or state transitions. A first native main POST has an unknown owner; only frozen file/Record relations or a validated original metadata target identify a later writer's Skill. The body-current acceptance message discloses accepted_current/unknown separately from accepted_observed/needs_review and does not rewrite the original outcome. No finite model, configuration or statechart input changed after the ten retained/native AcknowledgedContinuation checks; that run is reused for the unchanged semantics, not presented as a fresh check of request classification.

unmodeled_bindings.name: independent_native_file_add_current_acceptance
unmodeled_bindings.scope: This separate explicit author decision is outside all six bounded transition systems. It accepts only one same-page ordinary native add with an exact retained known body-mismatch outcome after an authorized repair to the frozen candidate; a complete original request/ACK was not retained and old completion remains unproven. Original plan/failure, original author Store and credential, exact owner/File/page, complete native bytes, original snapshot, relations and frontier bind the decision. The new review, distinct adopted event and independent completion use existing durable Record dispatch/ACK guards. The original add event is never emitted, the original needs_review outcome stays unchanged, and no native page/body/property is written. Unknown new writes never replay; cold verification checks full shared evidence, not local objects or one digest. Later legitimate author edits remain separate from historical acceptance. Exact JSON/body/hash/size bounds, budgets, transport behavior and cold fact validation need implementation and live tests; no new TLC or statechart result is asserted.

unmodeled_bindings.name: fixed_resource_batch_readonly_effects
unmodeled_bindings.scope: Fixed resource batches carry the existing consumption policy into the existing semantic Notion write guard and report effects on ready/failed/cancelled outcomes. RESOURCE_READ_EFFECTS_VERSION=1 declares batch support separately from scalar support. No resource-lifecycle state, acquisition identity, write authority, retry or recovery transition changes. AuditRun does not model these SDK/argument/receipt paths; original models/cfg/views and named results are reused without a fresh TLC run.
unmodeled_bindings.counterexample: Before the fix, readOnly:true allowed one controlled descendant semantic write to reach transport; strict mode now returns NOTION_READ_ONLY with zero writes. The normal control still reaches transport once.

unmodeled_bindings.name: native_draft_audit_classification_and_historical_rules
unmodeled_bindings.scope: Disabled empty-identity pages remain outside consumer discovery and are classified before managed-tree inspection. Complete metadata may pass while content/history stay unobserved. Residual fields, reverse rows and malformed/partial observations remain findings. Known v1 observations stay readable offline but cannot resume or provide a v2 incremental baseline. Original read-only transport, reverse-census completeness and checkpoint rules remain. AuditRun abstracts these owners and does not prove concrete field classification, CLI exit states, package environment isolation or HTTP bytes.
unmodeled_bindings.counterexample: Original shared directory classifies a disabled empty-ID page as unregistered while full audit reports both missing identities and incomplete managed inspection. Four of the five initial tests fail before production edits.

maintenance.routing: Relevant protected-source, model, config, view, coverage, runner and skill changes run this suite in formal CI. Use --model for a reviewed local slice.
maintenance.view_only: Rerun the affected existing positive/negative configs, retain exact bug paths and render with /statechart; no expanded proof claim.
maintenance.model_semantics: Review every declared rule, finite bound and environment/fairness assumption; keep exact expected negatives.
maintenance.implementation_semantics: Trace named functions and callers before updating hashes; run corresponding real-code regressions and guard mutations. Hash-only refresh cannot satisfy this review.
maintenance.rule_inventory: cases.expected_rules is a reviewed independent inventory. Do not regenerate it automatically from modified cfg files.

formal_maintenance_review.basis: Existing frozen config inventory migrated without changing TLA, cfg or protected source.

maintenance_state_review.proof_boundary: Existing AuditRun six-case check plus independent concrete regressions; no new field invariant is inferred from a source hash.

maintenance_review.claim: Source correspondence reviewed; this metadata itself is not a new run. Exact result scope is the final runner summary plus concrete original artifacts.
maintenance_review.format_only_followup: After the semantic review, Biome normalized formatting; the exact resulting source bytes are recorded here.
